options.content:
**SMARD** (Bundesnetzagentur electricity market data, crawler `smard`, schema `smard`). Germany, **hourly** values, instants in UTC.
Column unit `MWh` per hour equals the average power in MW, so charts show MW. Prices are EUR/MWh.

Data quirks:
* `generation.kernenergie` is empty after the German nuclear phase-out (last value Jan 2024).
* `frequency_reserve` volumes (`volumen_(+/-)`) and net revenues are empty since 2023, only the price column is filled. Its meaning is not documented by the crawler (module ids 15004382-90).
* `power_flow`/`allocation`: exports positive, imports negative; `nettoexport` is the sum. Flow data lags generation by 1-2 days.
* `market` contains the DE/AT/LU price only until Sep 2018 (column `de/at/lu`).
* Forecast table (`forecast_day_ahead`) contains the day-ahead forecast and reaches into the future.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(datum_von,$__interval), avg("kernenergie_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "nuclear", avg("braunkohle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "lignite", avg("steinkohle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "hard coal", avg("erdgas_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "gas", avg("sonstige_konventionelle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "other conventional", avg("biomasse_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "biomass", avg("sonstige_erneuerbare_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "other renewable", avg("wasserkraft_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "hydro", avg("wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "wind offshore", avg("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "wind onshore", avg("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "solar" from smard.generation where $__timeFilter(datum_von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Renewable share of load

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(g.datum_von,$__interval), 100*sum(coalesce("biomasse_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("sonstige_erneuerbare_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("wasserkraft_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0))/nullif(sum(c."netzlast_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen"),0) as "renewables / grid load",
100*sum(coalesce("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0)+coalesce("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen",0))/nullif(sum(c."netzlast_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen"),0) as "wind + solar / grid load"

panels.title: Wind and solar: SMARD vs ENTSO-E

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(datum_von,$__interval), avg("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "SMARD wind onshore", avg("wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "SMARD wind offshore", avg("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "SMARD solar" from smard.generation where $__timeFilter(datum_von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: ENTSO-E generation of the DE_LU zone as stacked mix for visual comparison with the SMARD mix above.

panels.title: Annual generation by source (all years)

targets.rawSql: select extract(year from datum_von)::text as year, sum("kernenergie_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "nuclear" , sum("braunkohle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "lignite" , sum("steinkohle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "hard coal" , sum("erdgas_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "gas" , sum("sonstige_konventionelle_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "other conventional" , sum("pumpspeicher_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "pumped storage" , sum("biomasse_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "biomass" , sum("sonstige_erneuerbare_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "other renewable" , sum("wasserkraft_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "hydro" , sum("wind_offshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "wind offshore" , sum("wind_onshore_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "wind onshore" , sum("photovoltaik_[mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen")/1e6 as "solar" from smard.generation group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Yearly net public generation in TWh, complete history (independent of the time range). 2026 is a partial year. Shows the phase-out of nuclear and coal and the growth of wind and solar.

panels.title: Balancing energy price (SMARD frequency_reserve)

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(datum_von,$__interval), avg("preis_[€/mwh]_berechnete_auflösungen") as "price" from smard.frequency_reserve where $__timeFilter(datum_von) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Price column of the SMARD balancing energy (Regelenergie) module in EUR/MWh. Volumes and net revenue columns of this table are empty after 2023. Note: the data differs from the DE-LU day-ahead price (correlation about 0.5).
